verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs say transformations run automatically after connection syncs, not only on a set schedule. They also describe a Fivetran-hosted dbt Core integration and orchestration of dbt Cloud transformations in the destination, which covers running dbt on freshly loaded data within the pipeline. Missing for 10: detail on how dbt runs are gated when models depend on multiple connectors, documented behavior when a sync fails or is partial, and independent or hands-on confirmation that sync-triggered dbt runs work as described.
